description_en: Updates the minor version of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 升级目标AnalyticDB MySQL版集群的内核版本
name: UpgradeKernelVersion

parameters.description_en:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region, including cluster IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
集群ID。

> 您可以通过[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看账号下AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群的集群ID。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_zh:

> 您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看账号下AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.description_en:
The minor version to which you want to update.

>  You can call the **DescribeKernelVersion** operation to query the supported minor versions.
parameters.description_zh:
需要升级到的目标内核版本。
> 您可以调用**DescribeKernelVersion**接口查询集群支持的内核版本列表。

parameters.description_en:
The time when to perform the update. Valid values:

*   **0** (default): immediately performs the update.
*   **1**: performs the update during the maintenance window.

>  You can call the [ModifyDBClusterMaintainTime](~~612236~~) operation to modify the maintenance window of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.
parameters.description_zh:
执行时间，取值：
* **0**：立即执行，默认值。
* **1**：在可维护时间段执行。

> 您可以调用[ModifyDBClusterMaintainTime](~~612236~~)修改集群的可维护时间段。
